transcript.text: All right, let's wrap up the show on a beautiful note today. Since this is the final episode… Did you know there's a viewpoint nearby at Khao Kheow Open Zoo?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アオ・ラ・ワン・二ー・ロー・マ・チョブ・รายการ・コー・スーイ・スーイ・カン・ディー・グワー・プロ・ペン・EP・スッテー・レオ・ル・マイ・ワー・ティ・スー・アン・サット・クー・カオ・ミー・จุด・ชม・ヴィウ・ドゥワイ・ナ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: All right , let 's wrap up the show on a beautiful note today . Since this is the final episode … Did you know there 's a viewpoint nearby at Khao Kheow Open Zoo ?

translations.ja: さあ、今日は最後を締めくくるのにふさわしい素敵な場所で番組を終わりましょう。最終回ですからね…カオキアオオープン動物園の近くに見晴らしの良い展望台があるのをご存知ですか？
translations.en: All right, let's wrap up the show on a beautiful note today. Since this is the final episode… Did you know there's a viewpoint nearby at Khao Kheow Open Zoo?
translations.ko: 자, 오늘 방송을 아름다운 분위기로 마무리해 볼까요? 오늘이 마지막 회인 만큼… 카오키요 개방 동물원 근처에 전망대가 있다는 거 아시나요?
translations.zh-TW: 好了，我們今天就在美好的氣氛中為節目畫下句點。既然今天是最後一集……你知道綠山國家動物園附近有一個觀景台嗎？
translations.id: Baiklah, mari kita akhiri acara hari ini dengan catatan yang indah. Karena ini adalah episode terakhir... Tahukah kalian bahwa ada titik pandang di dekat Kebun Binatang Terbuka Khao Kheow?
translations.pt: Muito bem, vamos encerrar o programa com uma nota bonita hoje. Como este é o episódio final… Você sabia que há um mirante ali perto no Zoológico Aberto de Khao Kheow?

transcript.text: Let's head over there and enjoy the view. We'll listen to some beautiful songs from the guys. Let's go!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: パイ・チュム・ヴィウ・カン・ディー・グワー・ファン・プレーン・プロ・プロ・ジャーク・ノーン・ノーン・カン・パイ・カン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Let 's head over there and enjoy the view . We 'll listen to some beautiful songs from the guys . Let 's go !

translations.ja: 景色を楽しみに行きましょう。みんなの素敵な歌声も聴けますよ。レッツゴー！
translations.en: Let's head over there and enjoy the view. We'll listen to some beautiful songs from the guys. Let's go!
translations.ko: 거기로 가서 경치를 즐겨봐요. 멤버들이 부르는 아름다운 노래도 들을 거고요. 가자!
translations.zh-TW: 我們過去那裡欣賞風景吧。一邊聽男生們唱幾首好聽的歌。我們走吧！
translations.id: Mari kita pergi ke sana dan menikmati pemandangannya. Kita akan mendengarkan beberapa lagu indah dari rekan-rekan kita. Ayo berangkat!
translations.pt: Vamos até lá e aproveitar a vista. Vamos ouvir algumas músicas bonitas dos rapazes. Vamos lá!

transcript.text: We're at the viewpoint now. -The atmosphere is really nice, isn't it? -It's great. The breeze is so cool.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: トニー・ロー・ユー・ティー・ジュット・チュム・ヴィウ・レオ・ナ・クラップ・バンヤーガート・ディー・マーク・ルーイ・チャイ・マイ・クラップ・ラムバット・イェン・サバーイ・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: We 're at the viewpoint now . -The atmosphere is really nice , isn 't it ? -It 's great . The breeze is so cool .

translations.ja: 展望台に到着しました！雰囲気すごく良いですね〜。風が涼しくて最高です。
translations.en: We're at the viewpoint now. -The atmosphere is really nice, isn't it? -It's great. The breeze is so cool.
translations.ko: 지금 전망대에 와 있어요. -분위기가 정말 좋지 않나요? -정말 좋아요. 산바람이 아주 시원해요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們現在到觀景台了。 -氣氛真的很棒，對吧？ -太棒了。微風好涼爽。
translations.id: Kita sekarang berada di titik pandang. - Suasananya sangat menyenangkan, ya? - Hebat sekali. Anginnya sepoi-sepoi dan sejuk.
translations.pt: Estamos no mirante agora. - O clima é muito bom, não é? - É ótimo. A brisa está tão fresca.

transcript.text: The scenery behind us is beautiful too. [KHAO KHEOW OPEN ZOO TRAINING CENTER.] Let's talk about the trip as a whole. Charge. Chill. Change.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヴィウ・カーン・ラング・コー・スーイ・ドゥワイ・ナ・クラップ・ロー・マー・คุย・カン・キアウ・ガブ・トリップ・二ー・チャージ・チル・チェンジ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: The scenery behind us is beautiful too . [KHAO KHEOW OPEN ZOO TRAINING CENTER .] Let 's talk about the trip as a whole . Charge . Chill . Change .

translations.ja: 背景の景色も本当にきれいですね（※カオキアオオープン動物園研修センター）。今回の「チャージ・チル・チェンジ」の旅全体について話しましょう。
translations.en: The scenery behind us is beautiful too. [KHAO KHEOW OPEN ZOO TRAINING CENTER.] Let's talk about the trip as a whole. Charge. Chill. Change.
translations.ko: 뒤에 펼쳐진 풍경도 정말 아름다워요. [카오키요 개방 동물원 연수 센터.] 이번 여행 전체에 대해 이야기해 봅시다. 충전, 휴식, 변화.
translations.zh-TW: 我們背後的風景也很美。[綠山國家動物園培訓中心。] 我們來談談這次的整體旅行。充飽電。放鬆。改變。
translations.id: Pemandangan di belakang kita juga indah. [PUSAT PELATIHAN KEBUN BINATANG TERBUKA KHAO KHEOW.] Mari kita bahas perjalanan ini secara keseluruhan. Isi ulang. Bersantai. Berubah.
translations.pt: A paisagem atrás de nós também está linda. [CENTRO DE TREINAMENTO DO ZOOLÓGICO ABERTO DE KHAO KHEOW.] Vamos falar sobre a viagem como um todo. Recarregar. Descontrair. Mudar.

transcript.text: So, how was it? What did each of you learn? What did you enjoy most about this one-day trip? Today, I feel like I've had a little vacation. Just like the concept says.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ペン・ヤンライ・バーン・ダーイ・リアン・ルー・アライ・バーン・チョープ・アライ・ティスット・プロ・ワン・二ー・ルースック・ムアン・ダーイ・パックポーン・タム・コンセプト・ルーイ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So , how was it ? What did each of you learn ? What did you enjoy most about this one-day trip ? Today , I feel like I 've had a little vacation . Just like the concept says .

translations.ja: いかがでしたか？何が一番勉強になりましたか？日帰り旅で何が一番楽しかったですか？今日は本当にコンセプト通り、プチ休暇に来た気分でした。
translations.en: So, how was it? What did each of you learn? What did you enjoy most about this one-day trip? Today, I feel like I've had a little vacation. Just like the concept says.
translations.ko: 자, 어땠나요? 각자 무엇을 배웠나요? 이번 당일치기 여행에서 가장 즐거웠던 점은 무엇인가요? 오늘은 마치 작은 휴가를 다녀온 기분이에요. 콘셉트 그대로 말이죠.
translations.zh-TW: 那麼，感覺如何？你們各自學到了什麼？這次一日遊你最喜歡什麼？今天，我覺得自己像是度了一個小假。就跟這個概念一樣。
translations.id: Jadi, bagaimana rasanya? Apa yang dipelajari oleh masing-masing dari kalian? Apa yang paling kalian nikmati dari perjalanan satu hari ini? Hari ini, rasanya aku menjalani liburan kecil. Sesuai dengan konsepnya.
translations.pt: Então, como foi? O que cada um de vocês aprendeu? O que vocês mais curtiram nesta viagem de um dia? Hoje, sinto que tive um pequenoas férias. Assim como diz o conceito.

transcript.text: I got to chill and recharge.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ダーイ・チル・ダーイ・チャージ・パラン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I got to chill and recharge .

translations.ja: チルしてリフレッシュ（チャージ）できました。
translations.en: I got to chill and recharge.
translations.ko: 휴식을 취하고 재충전할 수 있었어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我得到了放鬆並重新充電。
translations.id: Aku bisa bersantai dan mengisi ulang tenaga.
translations.pt: Eu pude relaxar e recarregar as energias.

transcript.text: And exchange knowledge with everyone. [SHARING EXPERIENCES.] This was actually my first time meeting PERSES. Even though we've had two seasons, this is the first episode where we've finally met.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レ・ダーイ・ラックプリアン・クワーム・ルー・ガブ・トゥック・コン・カ・ジャン・ダーイ・ジェー・パーセス・ペン・クラン・エーク・トゥン・ロー・ミー・ソーン・シーズン・テー・EP・二ー・ペン・EP・エーク・ティー・ダーイ・カン・ジェー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And exchange knowledge with everyone . [SHARING EXPERIENCES .] This was actually my first time meeting PERSES . Even though we 've had two seasons , this is the first episode where we 've finally met .

translations.ja: みなさんと知識を共有（チェンジ）できましたし。実はPERSESのみんなと会うのは今回が初めてだったんですよね。2シーズンやってきて、このEPでようやく直接お会いできました。
translations.en: And exchange knowledge with everyone. [SHARING EXPERIENCES.] This was actually my first time meeting PERSES. Even though we've had two seasons, this is the first episode where we've finally met.
translations.ko: 그리고 모두와 지식을 나눌 수 있었죠. [경험 공유.] 사실 퍼시스(PERSES)를 만난 건 이번이 처음이에요. 시즌이 두 개나 있었지만, 마침내 만나게 된 건 이번 에피소드가 처음이에요.
translations.zh-TW: 還和大家交流了知識。[分享經驗。] 這其實是我第一次見到 PERSES。儘管我們已經做了兩季，但這是我們終於見面的第一集。
translations.id: Dan bertukar pengetahuan dengan semua orang. [BERBAGI PENGALAMAN.] Ini sebenarnya pertama kalinya aku bertemu PERSES. Meskipun kita sudah melewati dua musim, ini adalah episode pertama di mana kita akhirnya bertemu.
translations.pt: E trocar conhecimento com todo mundo. [COMPARTILHANDO EXPERIÊNCIas.] Esta foi, na verdade, a minha primeira vez conhecendo o PERSES. Embora já tenhamos tido duas temporadas, este é o primeiro episódio em que finalmente nos conhecemos.

transcript.text: I was really happy. It felt like making new friends. It was like coming here to learn new things. And there were so many fun activities to enjoy.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・クワーム・スック・マーク・ルースック・ムアン・ダーイ・プアン・モーイ・ダーイ・マー・リアン・ルー・アライ・モーイ・レ・ミー・コーン・グラッティノ・サヌック・サヌック・マーク・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I was really happy . It felt like making new friends . It was like coming here to learn new things . And there were so many fun activities to enjoy .

translations.ja: すごく嬉しかったです。新しい友達ができたみたいで、新しいことを学びに来られたし、楽しいアクティビティも盛りだくさんでした。
translations.en: I was really happy. It felt like making new friends. It was like coming here to learn new things. And there were so many fun activities to enjoy.
translations.ko: 정말 기뻤어요. 새로운 친구들을 사귄 것 같았어요. 여기에 와서 새로운 것들을 배우는 것 같았죠. 그리고 즐길 수 있는 재미있는 활동도 정말 많았어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我真的很高興。感覺就像交了新朋友。就像來這裡學習新事物一樣。而且有那麼多好玩的活動可以體驗。
translations.id: Aku sangat senang. Rasanya seperti mendapat teman baru. Rasanya seperti datang ke sini untuk mempelajari hal-hal baru. Dan ada begitu banyak kegiatan seru yang bisa dinikmati.
translations.pt: Eu fiquei muito feliz. Parecia fazer novos amigos. Foi como vir aqui para aprender coisas novas. E houve tantas atividades divertidas para aproveitar.

transcript.text: How was the trip, William? You're joining us for the first time this season. What did you enjoy most today? I liked getting to see the animals. I've been to the zoo before, too.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: トリップ・二ー・ペン・ヤンライ・バーン・ウィリアム・マー・シーズン・二ー・ペン・クラン・エーク・チョープ・アライ・ティスット・カ・チョープ・ダーイ・ドゥー・サット・コー・キー・ケーイ・マー・スー・アン・サット・マー・コー・二ー・レオ・ドゥワイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: How was the trip , William ? You 're joining us for the first time this season . What did you enjoy most today ? I liked getting to see the animals . I 've been to the zoo before , too .

translations.ja: 今回の旅はどうだった、ウィリアム？今シーズン初参加だけど、今日何が一番楽しかった？「動物を見られたのが良かったです。前にも動物園には来たことがあったんですけど…」
translations.en: How was the trip, William? You're joining us for the first time this season. What did you enjoy most today? I liked getting to see the animals. I've been to the zoo before, too.
translations.ko: 여행은 어땠나요, 윌리엄? 이번 시즌에 처음 합류하셨죠. 오늘 가장 즐거웠던 점은 무엇인가요? 동물들을 볼 수 있어서 좋았어요. 동물원에는 전에도 와본 적이 있거든요.
translations.zh-TW: William，這次旅行感覺如何？你這季是第一次加入。今天你最喜歡什麼？我喜歡看動物。我以前也去過動物園。
translations.id: Bagaimana perjalanannya, William? Kamu bergabung dengan kami untuk pertama kalinya musim ini. Apa yang paling kamu nikmati hari ini? Aku suka bisa melihat hewan-hewan. Aku pernah ke kebun binatang sebelumnya juga.
translations.pt: Como foi a viagem, William? Você está se juntando a nós pela primeira vez nesta temporada. O que você mais curtiu hoje? Eu gostei de ver os animais. Eu já tinha ido ao zoológico antes também.

transcript.text: But I was really impressed by that one. -The one that came and clung onto me. -The lemur! My little lemur! My little lemur.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・プロンプ・ガブ・トゥア・ナーン・マー・コー・ヘン・ルーマー・ノン・キツネザル・ノン・キツネザル・コン・チャン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: But I was really impressed by that one . -The one that came and clung onto me . -The lemur ! My little lemur ! My little lemur .

translations.ja: 「でも、あの子にしがみつかれたのがすごく印象的で…」「ワオキツネザルね！僕のワオキツネザルちゃん！僕の可愛いワオキツネザル〜」
translations.en: But I was really impressed by that one. -The one that came and clung onto me. -The lemur! My little lemur! My little lemur.
translations.ko: 하지만 그게 정말 인상 깊었어요. -저한테 와서 매달렸던 그 동물요. -여우원숭이요! 내 작은 여우원숭이! 내 작은 여우원숭이.
translations.zh-TW: 但我對那隻印象深刻。 -那隻跑過來抱住我的。 -狐猴！我的小狐猴！我的小狐猴。
translations.id: Tapi aku sangat terkesan dengan yang itu. - Yang datang dan bergelantungan di tubuhku. - Lemur! Lemur kecilku! Lemur kecilku.
translations.pt: Mas fiquei muito impressionado com aquele. - Aquele que veio e se agarrou em mim. - O lêmure! Meu pequeno lêmure! Meu pequeno lêmure.

transcript.text: I loved it because I'd never seen one before. I learned so much today. Because it's been a really long time since I last visited EGAT. So it was great to be back again.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チョープ・プロ・マイ・ケーイ・ジェー・モーイ・コー・二ー・ワン・二ー・ダーイ・クワーム・ルー・イエ・マーク・プロ・マイ・ダーイ・マー・イーガット・ナーン・マーク・レオ・ダーイ・グラッブ・マー・イーク・クラン・コー・ディー・マーク・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I loved it because I 'd never seen one before . I learned so much today . Because it 's been a really long time since I last visited EGAT . So it was great to be back again .

translations.ja: 「見たことなかったからすごく好きでした。今日はたくさんのことを学べました。EGAT（※タイ発電公社）に来るのも久しぶりだったので、また来られて本当に良かったです。」
translations.en: I loved it because I'd never seen one before. I learned so much today. Because it's been a really long time since I last visited EGAT. So it was great to be back again.
translations.ko: 전에도 본 적이 없어서 정말 좋았어요. 오늘 정말 많은 걸 배웠어요. EGAT에 마지막으로 방문한 지 정말 오래되었거든요. 그래서 다시 오게 되어 정말 좋았어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我超喜歡，因為我從沒見過。我今天學到了很多。因為我上次參觀 EGAT 已經是很久以前的事了。所以能再次回來真的很棒。
translations.id: Aku menyukainya karena aku belum pernah melihatnya sebelumnya. Aku belajar banyak hari ini. Karena sudah sangat lama sejak terakhir kali aku mengunjungi EGAT. Jadi sangat menyenangkan bisa kembali lagi.
translations.pt: Eu adorei porque nunca tinha visto um antes. Eu aprendi tanto hoje. Porque hace muito tempo que não visito a EGAT. Então foi ótimo estar de volta.

transcript.text: I also got to meet the guys from PERSES.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レ・ダーイ・ジェー・ノーン・ノーン・パーセス・ドゥワイ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I also got to meet the guys from PERSES .

translations.ja: 「PERSESのみんなにも会えましたしね。」
translations.en: I also got to meet the guys from PERSES.
translations.ko: 그리고 퍼시스 친구들도 만나게 되었고요.
translations.zh-TW: 我還見到了 PERSES 的成員們。
translations.id: Aku juga bisa bertemu dengan anak-anak PERSES.
translations.pt: Eu também pude conhecer os rapazes do PERSES.

transcript.text: And we even got one of the popular ones here! [PERSES'S POWERHOUSE!] When I first saw Krittin, I thought he was a quiet person. Because we kept running into each other in the elevator.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レ・イーク・コン・ティー・ガン・マー・トニー・カ・コー・クー・クリッティン・トーン・ジェー・カン・クラン・エーク・キット・ワー・ケー・ペン・コン・ギアップ・ギアップ・プロ・ジェー・カン・ナイ・リフ・ボイ・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And we even got one of the popular ones here ! [PERSES'S POWERHOUSE !] When I first saw Krittin , I thought he was a quiet person . Because we kept running into each other in the elevator .

translations.ja: 「それから人気のこの子も！（※PERSESのムードメーカー！）最初クリッティンを見た時、静かな人だと思ってたんだよ。エレベーターでよく一緒になってたから。」
translations.en: And we even got one of the popular ones here! [PERSES'S POWERHOUSE!] When I first saw Krittin, I thought he was a quiet person. Because we kept running into each other in the elevator.
translations.ko: 게다가 여기 인기 멤버 중 한 명도 얻게 되었죠! [퍼시스의 파워하우스!] 크리틴을 처음 봤을 때, 저는 그가 조용한 사람인 줄 알았어요. 엘리베이터에서 계속 마주쳤거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們甚至還遇到了這裡的超人氣成員！[PERSES 的實力派！] 我第一次見到 Krittin 時，覺得他是一個安靜的人。因為我們在電梯裡一直巧遇。
translations.id: Dan kita bahkan mendapatkan salah satu yang populer di sini! [KEKUATAN PERSES!] Saat pertama kali melihat Krittin, kupikir dia orang yang pendiam. Karena kami terus berpapasan di lift.
translations.pt: E ainda levamos um dos mais populares daqui! [A POTÊNCIA DO PERSES!] Quando vi o Krittin pela primeira vez, achei que ele era uma pessoa quieta. Porque a gente ficava se esbarrando no elevador.

transcript.text: I always said hi to him. I even told him I really liked the song, BODYGUARD. He seemed so quiet this morning. But once the sun came out, he really came alive! -What do you mean? -The sun came out?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: タック・ターイ・タロード・ボーク・チョープ・プレーン・ボディガード・トーン・チャオ・ドゥー・ンギアップ・ンギアップ・ポー・デート・オーク・ソッサーイ・ルーイ・マイ・クワーム・ワー・ンガイ・デート・オーク・ロー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I always said hi to him . I even told him I really liked the song , BODYGUARD . He seemed so quiet this morning . But once the sun came out , he really came alive ! -What do you mean ? -The sun came out ?

translations.ja: 僕、いつも挨拶してたんですよ。「BODYGUARD」って曲がすごく好きだとも伝えて。今朝は静かな人だなと思ってたのに、太陽が出てきたら急にテンション上がって！ -どういうこと？ -太陽が出たら？
translations.en: I always said hi to him. I even told him I really liked the song, BODYGUARD. He seemed so quiet this morning. But once the sun came out, he really came alive! -What do you mean? -The sun came out?
translations.ko: 저는 항상 그에게 인사를 건넸어요. 'BODYGUARD'라는 노래를 정말 좋아한다고 말하기도 했죠. 오늘 아침엔 엄청 조용해 보이더라고요. 그런데 해가 뜨니까 진짜 활기차졌어요! -무슨 뜻이야? -해가 떴다고?
translations.zh-TW: 我一直跟他說嗨，還跟他說我真的很喜歡《BODYGUARD》這首歌。他今天早上看起來好安靜，但太陽一出來，他整個人都活過來了！ -什麼意思？ -太陽出來了？
translations.id: Aku selalu menyapanya. Bahkan kubilang aku sangat menyukai lagu itu, BODYGUARD. Dia tampak sangat pendiam pagi ini. Tapi begitu matahari terbit, dia benar-benar menjadi sangat aktif! -Maksudmu apa? -Matahari terbit?
translations.pt: Eu sempre o cumprimentava. Até disse que gostava muito da música BODYGUARD. Ele parecia tão calmo hoje de manhã. Mas assim que o sol apareceu, ele se animou de verdade! -O que você quer dizer? -O sol apareceu?

transcript.text: When the sun came out? -Did he get possessed or something? -As soon as the sun came out, wow! He was fired up first thing in the morning! In Season 1, we had Hong from EGAT. This season, we have Nut from EGAT instead.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポー・デート・オーク・コー・シン・シン・スート・ルーイ・ルー・プラウ・ポー・デート・オーク・プップ・キー・クリック・ルーイ・シーサン・ニー・ミー・ピー・ナット・ジャー・イージーエーティー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: When the sun came out ? -Did he get possessed or something ? -As soon as the sun came out , wow ! He was fired up first thing in the morning ! In Season 1 , we had Hong from EGAT . This season , we have Nut from EGAT instead .

translations.ja: 太陽が出たら？ -何か憑依でもしたの？ -太陽が出た途端、ワーッ！って朝一番から大張り切りでした！シーズン1はEGATのホンさんでしたが、今シーズンはEGATのナットさんが出演してくださっています。
translations.en: When the sun came out? -Did he get possessed or something? -As soon as the sun came out, wow! He was fired up first thing in the morning! In Season 1, we had Hong from EGAT. This season, we have Nut from EGAT instead.
translations.ko: 해가 떴을 때? -뭐 빙의라도 됐나? -해가 뜨자마자 와! 아침부터 아주 그냥 불타올랐더라고요! 시즌 1에는 EGAT의 홍 님이 있었죠. 이번 시즌에는 대신 EGAT의 넛 님이 함께합니다.
translations.zh-TW: 太陽出來的時候？ -他被附身了嗎？ -太陽一出來，哇！一大早就超有活力！第一季我們有 EGAT 的 Hong，這一季則有 EGAT 的 Nut。
translations.id: Saat matahari terbit? -Apa dia kerasukan sesuatu? -Begitu matahari terbit, wah! Dia langsung bersemangat sejak pagi hari! Di Musim 1, kita punya Hong dari EGAT. Musim ini, kita punya Nut dari EGAT.
translations.pt: Quando o sol apareceu? -Ele foi possuído ou algo assim? -Assim que o sol apareceu, nossa! Ele estava super animado logo cedo! Na 1ª temporada, tivemos o Hong da EGAT. Nesta temporada, temos o Nut da EGAT.

transcript.text: I've learned so much this season. Especially about the EleXA application. And the Elex by EGAT charging stations.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ダイ・リーン・ルー・イェッ・イェッ・シーサン・ニー・ドーイ・チェポー・アプリケーシャン・エレクサ・レ・サターニー・チャージ・エレックス・バイ・イージーエーティー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 've learned so much this season . Especially about the EleXA application . And the Elex by EGAT charging stations .

translations.ja: 今シーズンは本当にたくさんのことを学びました。特にEleXA（エレクサ）アプリや、Elex by EGATの充電ステーションについてですね。
translations.en: I've learned so much this season. Especially about the EleXA application. And the Elex by EGAT charging stations.
translations.ko: 이번 시즌에 정말 많은 걸 배웠어요. 특히 EleXA 애플리케이션에 대해서요. 그리고 EGAT의 Elex 충전소에 대해서도요.
translations.zh-TW: 這一季我學到了很多，特別是關於 EleXA 應用程式，以及 EGAT 的 Elex 充電站。
translations.id: Aku belajar banyak hal musim ini. Terutama tentang aplikasi EleXA. Dan stasiun pengisian daya Elex by EGAT.
translations.pt: Aprendi tanto nesta temporada. Especialmente sobre o aplicativo EleXA. E as estações de recarga Elex by EGAT.

transcript.text: I'd never used them before. This was my first time trying them out. I feel like I've gained so much knowledge. That's great! I'd like to recommend it to the viewers, too.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: マイ・ケーイ・チャイ・マー・コー・ルーイ・ニー・ペン・カン・レーック・ダイ・クワーム・ルー・マー・イェッ・マーック・ディー・ジャン・ヤーック・ネーナム・ファンファン・ドゥーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 'd never used them before . This was my first time trying them out . I feel like I 've gained so much knowledge . That 's great ! I 'd like to recommend it to the viewers , too .

translations.ja: 今まで使ったことがなくて、今回初めて体験したんです。すごく勉強になりました！最高ですね！視聴者のみなさんにもぜひオススメしたいです。
translations.en: I'd never used them before. This was my first time trying them out. I feel like I've gained so much knowledge. That's great! I'd like to recommend it to the viewers, too.
translations.ko: 전 한 번도 써본 적이 없었거든요. 이번에 처음 써본 거였어요. 지식이 정말 많이 늘어난 것 같아요. 정말 좋네요! 시청자분들께도 추천해 드리고 싶어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我以前從沒用過，這是我第一次嘗試。我覺得自己收穫了好多知識，真棒！我也想把它推薦給觀眾們。
translations.id: Aku belum pernah menggunakannya sebelumnya. Ini pertama kalinya aku mencobanya. Rasanya aku mendapatkan banyak sekali pengetahuan. Bagus sekali! Aku ingin merekomendasikannya kepada para penonton juga.
translations.pt: Eu nunca os tinha usado antes. Esta foi a minha primeira vez testando. Sinto que adquiri tanto conhecimento. Que ótimo! Gostaria de recomendar aos espectadores também.

transcript.text: If you're thinking about changing your car around this time, -I'd definitely recommend an EV, right? -Exactly! -It'll help you save money. -That's right.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ター・カン・カン・カン・プロム・プロム・プロム・ペリヤン・ロッ・トーン・ニー・ネーナム・ロッ・イーヴィー・ルーイ・チャイ・マイ・チャイ・ルーイ・プロム・プラヤット・ンガイ・チャイ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: If you 're thinking about changing your car around this time , -I 'd definitely recommend an EV , right ? -Exactly ! -It 'll help you save money . -That 's right .

translations.ja: もし今、車の買い替えを考えているなら、-EV（電気自動車）が絶対オススメですよね？ -その通り！ -節約にもなりますしね。 -そうなんです。
translations.en: If you're thinking about changing your car around this time, -I'd definitely recommend an EV, right? -Exactly! -It'll help you save money. -That's right.
translations.ko: 요즘 차를 바꿀까 고민 중이시라면, -EV를 강력 추천하시겠죠? -맞아요! -비용 절약에도 도움이 될 테니까요. -맞습니다.
translations.zh-TW: 如果你這陣子正考慮換車， -我一定會推薦電動車對吧？ -沒錯！ -它能幫你省錢。 -對啊。
translations.id: Jika kalian berencana mengganti mobil kalian akhir-akhir ini, -aku pasti merekomendasikan kendaraan listrik, kan? -Tepat sekali! -Itu akan membantumu menghemat uang. -Benar sekali.
translations.pt: Se você está pensando em trocar de carro por agora, -eu definitivamente recomendaria um VE, né? -Exato! -Isso vai te ajudar a economizar dinheiro. -É isso aí.

transcript.text: No more paying for fuel. You can switch to electricity instead. And charging is much more convenient than it used to be. There are charging stations all over the country now. What about you, P'Joong? How was it?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: マイ・トン・ジャーイ・カー・ナームマン・ハアン・マー・ハイ・ファイファー・レ・チャージ・サドゥアック・クン・マーック・ミー・サターニー・トア・プラテート・ルーイ・ピージュン・ラー・ペン・ガイ・バーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: No more paying for fuel . You can switch to electricity instead . And charging is much more convenient than it used to be . There are charging stations all over the country now . What about you , P 'Joong? How was it ?

translations.ja: もうガソリン代を払う必要がなくて、電気に切り替えられるんです。充電も昔よりずっと便利になって、全国に充電ステーションがありますから。ピージュンはどうでしたか？
translations.en: No more paying for fuel. You can switch to electricity instead. And charging is much more convenient than it used to be. There are charging stations all over the country now. What about you, P'Joong? How was it?
translations.ko: 기름값 걱정은 이제 그만. 전기로 바꿀 수 있으니까요. 게다가 충전도 예전보다 훨씬 편리해졌어요. 이제 전국 곳곳에 충전소가 있거든요. 쭝 님은 어떠셨어요? 어땠나요?
translations.zh-TW: 不用再付油錢了，你可以改用電力。而且現在充電比以前方便多了，全國各地到處都有充電站。你呢，P'Joong？感覺怎麼樣？
translations.id: Tidak perlu lagi membayar bahan bakar. Kalian bisa beralih ke listrik. Dan pengisian daya jauh lebih mudah daripada sebelumnya. Ada stasiun pengisian daya di seluruh negeri sekarang. Bagaimana denganmu, P'Joong? Bagaimana rasanya?
translations.pt: Chega de pagar por combustível. Você pode mudar para eletricidade. E carregar é muito mais conveniente do que costumava ser. Há estações de recarga por todo o país agora. E você, P'Joong? Como foi?

transcript.text: I feel like I've really gotten to experience clean energy today.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ルースック・ワー・ダイ・サムパット・パランガン・サアート・ヤーング・テー・ジン・トーン・ニー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I feel like I 've really gotten to experience clean energy today .

translations.ja: 今日はクリーンエネルギーを本気で体感できた気がします。
translations.en: I feel like I've really gotten to experience clean energy today.
translations.ko: 오늘 정말 청정 에너지를 제대로 체험해 본 것 같아요.
translations.zh-TW: 我覺得我今天真的體驗到了乾淨能源。
translations.id: Rasanya aku benar-benar bisa merasakan energi bersih hari ini.
translations.pt: Sinto que realmente pude vivenciar energia limpa hoje.

transcript.text: Good energy! [GETTING A FULL DOSE OF CLEAN ENERGY!] I'm also happy I got to come on this trip. Actually, ever since we visited the fish house and the crab bank.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: パランガン・ディー・ディー・ディー・イーク・ドゥーイ・ディー・ジャイ・ティー・ダイ・マー・トリップ・ニー・チンチン・タン・テー・パイ・バーン・プラー・レ・タナーカーン・プー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Good energy ! [GETTING A FULL DOSE OF CLEAN ENERGY !] I 'm also happy I got to come on this trip . Actually , ever since we visited the fish house and the crab bank .

translations.ja: 良いエネルギーですね！（※クリーンエネルギーを全身で体感中！） このトリップに来られて本当に良かったです。実は、魚の家やカニの銀行を見学した時から…
translations.en: Good energy! [GETTING A FULL DOSE OF CLEAN ENERGY!] I'm also happy I got to come on this trip. Actually, ever since we visited the fish house and the crab bank.
translations.ko: 좋은 에너지요! [청정 에너지를 듬뿍 받는 중!] 이번 여행에 올 수 있어서 저도 기쁩니다. 사실, 물고기 집이랑 게 은행에 갔을 때부터요.
translations.zh-TW: 美好的能源！[吸收滿滿的乾淨能源！] 我也很開心能參加這次的旅行。其實，從我們參觀魚寮和蟹銀行開始……
translations.id: Energi yang baik! [MENDAPATKAN DOSIS PENUH ENERGI BERSIH!] Aku juga senang bisa ikut dalam perjalanan ini. Sebenarnya, sejak kami mengunjungi rumah ikan dan bank kepiting.
translations.pt: Energia boa! [RECEBENDO UMA DOSE COMPLETA DE ENERGIA LIMPA!] Também estou feliz por ter vindo nesta viagem. Na verdade, desde que visitamos a casa de peixes e o banco de siris.

transcript.text: There are holes in the rice field, but do you have someone yet? As long as we have mangrove crabs, we'll always have stability.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ルー・ナー・ミー・ルー・タイ・テー・ミー・カイ・ルー・ヤン・ミー・プー・サメー・コー・ミー・クワーム・マンコン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: There are holes in the rice field , but do you have someone yet ? As long as we have mangrove crabs , we 'll always have stability .

translations.ja: 田んぼには穴があるけど、君にはもう大切な人はいる？（※タイの駄洒落） マングローブガニ（※プー・サメー）がいれば、僕たちにはいつだって安定（※マンコン）があるよ。
translations.en: There are holes in the rice field, but do you have someone yet? As long as we have mangrove crabs, we'll always have stability.
translations.ko: 논밭에 구멍이 뚫려 있지만, 혹시 임자는 있으신가요? 맹그로브 게가 있는 한, 우리에겐 언제나 안정이 있을 거예요.
translations.zh-TW: 稻田裡有洞，但你有伴了嗎？只要我們有紅樹林蟹，我們就永遠有穩定的生活。
translations.id: Ada lubang di sawah, tapi apakah kamu sudah punya seseorang? Selama kita memiliki kepiting bakau, kita akan selalu memiliki kestabilan.
translations.pt: Há buracos no campo de arroz, mas você já tem alguém? Enquanto tivermos siris-do-mangue, sempre teremos estabilidade.

transcript.text: [WE'LL HAVE A GAME FOR YOU TO PLAY AT THE END.]
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・ゲーム・ハイ・レーン・トーン・タイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: [WE'LL HAVE A GAME FOR YOU TO PLAY AT THE END .]

translations.ja: （※最後にみんなで遊ぶゲームがあるよ！）
translations.en: [WE'LL HAVE A GAME FOR YOU TO PLAY AT THE END.]
translations.ko: [마지막에 즐길 수 있는 게임이 준비되어 있습니다.]
translations.zh-TW: [我們最後為你準備了一個遊戲。]
translations.id: [KAMI PUNYA PERMAINAN UNTUK KALIAN MAINKAN DI AKHIR.]
translations.pt: [TEREMOS UM JOGO PARA VOCÊ JOGAR NO FINAL.]

transcript.text: I really loved it. It was my first time at Khao Kheow. I was so happy to see so many animals. I saw a rhino… An anteater…
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チョープ・マーック・ルーイ・マー・カオ・キアオ・カン・レーック・ディー・ジャイ・ティー・ダイ・ヒエン・サット・イェッ・イェッ・ヒエン・レット・ヒエン・トゥア・ギン・モット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I really loved it . It was my first time at Khao Kheow . I was so happy to see so many animals . I saw a rhino … An anteater …

translations.ja: すごく楽しかったです。カオ・キアオ（※カオキアオオープン動物園）に来たのは初めてで、たくさんの動物に会えて嬉しかったです。サイも見れたし… アリクイも…
translations.en: I really loved it. It was my first time at Khao Kheow. I was so happy to see so many animals. I saw a rhino… An anteater…
translations.ko: 정말 정말 좋았어요. 카오키여우는 처음이었거든요. 동물들을 이렇게 많이 보게 돼서 정말 기뻤어요. 코뿔소도 보고… 개미핥기도 보고…
translations.zh-TW: 我真的很喜歡。這是我第一次去綠山動物園，看到這麼多動物我好開心。我看到了犀牛……食蟻獸……
translations.id: Aku sangat menyukainya. Ini pertama kalinya aku ke Khao Kheow. Aku sangat senang melihat begitu banyak hewan. Aku melihat badak... Seekor pemakan semut...
translations.pt: Eu adorei de verdade. Foi minha primeira vez em Khao Kheow. Fiquei tão feliz em ver tantos animais. Vi um rinoceronte… Um tamanduá…

transcript.text: Especially the elephants. I really love them. Today's games were so much fun, too. And I was really happy to meet PERSES as well. What about you, P'Jung and P'Krit? How was this season for you?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チェポー・チャーン・チョープ・マーック・ゲーム・ワンニー・コー・サヌック・マーック・レ・ディー・ジャイ・ティー・ダイ・ジョー・パーセス・ドゥーイ・ピージャン・レ・ピークリット・ラー・ペン・ガイ・バーン・シーサン・ニー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Especially the elephants . I really love them . Today 's games were so much fun , too . And I was really happy to meet PERSES as well . What about you , P 'Jung and P 'Krit? How was this season for you ?

translations.ja: 特にゾウがすごく好きなんです。今日のゲームもすごく楽しかったし、PERSES（パーセス）に会えたのも本当に嬉しかったです。ピージャンとピークリットはどうでしたか？今シーズンはどうでした？
translations.en: Especially the elephants. I really love them. Today's games were so much fun, too. And I was really happy to meet PERSES as well. What about you, P'Jung and P'Krit? How was this season for you?
translations.ko: 특히 코끼리들이요. 정말 정말 좋아해요. 오늘 게임들도 너무 재미있었어요. 그리고 PERSES를 만나게 돼서 정말 기뻤답니다. 줭 님과 릿 님은 어떠셨어요? 이번 시즌은 두 분에게 어땠나요?
translations.zh-TW: 特別是大象，我真的很喜歡。今天的遊戲也好好玩，而且能見到 PERSES 我真的超開心。P'Jung 和 P'Krit 呢？這一季對你們來說怎麼樣？
translations.id: Terutama gajah-gajahnya. Aku sangat menyukai mereka. Permainan hari ini juga sangat seru. Dan aku sangat senang bisa bertemu PERSES juga. Bagaimana dengan kalian, P'Jung dan P'Krit? Bagaimana musim ini bagi kalian?
translations.pt: Especialmente os elefantes. Eu amo muito eles. Os jogos de hoje foram tão divertidos também. E fiquei muito feliz em conhecer o PERSES também. E vocês, P'Jung e P'Krit? Como foi esta temporada para vocês?

transcript.text: I've been working really hard lately. I've been cooped up in a room making music. Recording songs, writing songs, that kind of thing?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チュアン・ニー・タム・ガーン・ナック・マーック・ゴック・ユー・タイ・ホーン・タム・プレーン・アット・プレーン・テン・プレーン・アライ・ベーップ・ナン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 've been working really hard lately . I 've been cooped up in a room making music . Recording songs , writing songs , that kind of thing ?

translations.ja: 最近ずっと忙しく仕事をしていて、部屋にこもって音楽制作ばかりしてたんです。レコーディングしたり、曲を書いたり。
translations.en: I've been working really hard lately. I've been cooped up in a room making music. Recording songs, writing songs, that kind of thing?
translations.ko: 요즘 정말 열심히 일하고 있었거든요. 방에 틀어박혀서 음악을 만들고 있었어요. 곡 녹음하고, 곡 쓰고, 그런 거요?
translations.zh-TW: 我最近工作真的很忙，一直關在房間裡做音樂，錄音、寫歌之類的。
translations.id: Aku belakangan ini bekerja sangat keras. Aku berdiam diri di dalam ruangan untuk membuat musik. Merekam lagu, menulis lagu, hal-hal semacam itu?
translations.pt: Tenho trabalhado muito ultimamente. Fiquei trancado em um quarto fazendo música. Gravando músicas, compondo músicas, esse tipo de coisa?

transcript.text: So getting to go on a trip, explore new things… And meet new friends. It felt like a chance to refresh myself. I also got to learn more things. -It gave me inspiration, right? -Yes.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポー・ダイ・マー・トリップ・ダイ・トリエン・シー・マイマイ・レ・ダイ・ジョー・プアン・マイマイ・ルースック・ムアン・ダイ・リフレッシュ・ダイ・リーン・ルー・ペーム・イーク・ダイ・レン・バンダーン・ジャイ・チャイ・マイ・チャイ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So getting to go on a trip , explore new things … And meet new friends . It felt like a chance to refresh myself . I also got to learn more things . -It gave me inspiration , right ? -Yes .

translations.ja: だから旅に出て、新しい世界を体験して… 新しい友達にも出会えて、リフレッシュできた感じです。学びも増えました。 -インスピレーションも得られたんじゃない？ -はい、そうです。
translations.en: So getting to go on a trip, explore new things… And meet new friends. It felt like a chance to refresh myself. I also got to learn more things. -It gave me inspiration, right? -Yes.
translations.ko: 그래서 여행도 가고, 새로운 것들도 탐험하고… 새로운 친구들도 만나고요. 저를 재충전하는 기분이었어요. 새로운 것들도 더 배울 수 있었고요. -영감을 얻기도 했죠? -네.
translations.zh-TW: 所以能去旅行、探索新事物……還能結新朋友，感覺就像是一個重新整理自己的機會。我也學到了更多東西。 -這給了我靈感，對吧？ -是的。
translations.id: Jadi, bisa pergi berlibur, menjelajahi hal-hal baru... Dan bertemu teman-teman baru. Rasanya seperti kesempatan untuk menyegarkan diriku. Aku juga bisa mempelajari lebih banyak hal. -Itu memberiku inspirasi, kan? -Ya.
translations.pt: Então, poder fazer uma viagem, explorar coisas novas… E conhecer novos amigos. Pareceu uma chance de me refrescar. Também pude aprender mais coisas. -Isso me deu inspiração, né? -Sim.

transcript.text: You could even make a song about Khao Kheow!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テン・プレーン・ギヤウ・ガッブ・カオ・キアオ・ダイ・ルーイ・ナ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You could even make a song about Khao Kheow !

translations.ja: カオ・キアオについての曲も作れそうだね！
translations.en: You could even make a song about Khao Kheow!
translations.ko: 카오키여우에 관한 노래를 만들 수도 있겠어요!
translations.zh-TW: 你甚至可以寫一首關於綠山動物園的歌！
translations.id: Kalian bahkan bisa membuat lagu tentang Khao Kheow!
translations.pt: Você poderia até fazer uma música sobre Khao Kheow!

transcript.text: An EGAT song! [ARE YOU SERIOUSLY GOING THAT FAR?] Electricity, anteaters… Or maybe crabs! The next song is called "Crab Slide"!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プレーン・イージーエーティー・ファイファー・トゥア・ギン・モット・ルー・プー・プレーン・トープ・パイ・チュー・プー・スライド
transcript.pronunciation_roman: An EGAT song ! [ARE YOU SERIOUSLY GOING THAT FAR ?] Electricity , anteaters … Or maybe crabs ! The next song is called "Crab Slide "!

translations.ja: EGAT（※タイ発電公社）の曲だよ！（※そこまでやる気！？） 電気とか、アリクイとか… それかカニ！ 次の曲のタイトルは「カニ・スライド（Crab Slide）」だね！
translations.en: An EGAT song! [ARE YOU SERIOUSLY GOING THAT FAR?] Electricity, anteaters… Or maybe crabs! The next song is called "Crab Slide"!
translations.ko: EGAT 송이요! [정말 그렇게까지 하실 건가요?] 전기, 개미핥기… 아니면 게! 다음 곡 제목은 "크랩 슬라이드"입니다!
translations.zh-TW: EGAT 之歌！[你們認真要搞這麼大嗎？] 電力、食蟻獸……或者螃蟹！下一首歌就叫《螃蟹滑步》！
translations.id: Sebuah lagu EGAT! [APAKAH KAMU BENAR-BENAR BERNIAT SEJAUH ITU?] Listrik, pemakan semut... Atau mungkin kepiting! Lagu berikutnya berjudul "Crab Slide"!
translations.pt: Uma música da EGAT! [VOCÊ ESTÁ FALANDO SÉRIO INDO TÃO LONGE?] Eletricidade, tamanduás… Ou talvez siris! A próxima música se chama "Crab Slide"!

transcript.text: Thank you to EGAT for Bringing us all together. And giving us the chance to share this happiness today. We got to learn about clean energy.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: コップン・イージーエーティー・ティー・パー・ポック・ラオ・マー・ジョー・カン・レ・ダイ・シャー・クワーム・スク・カン・ワンニー・ダイ・リーン・ルー・ギヤウ・ガッブ・パランガン・サアート
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Thank you to EGAT for Bringing us all together . And giving us the chance to share this happiness today . We got to learn about clean energy .

translations.ja: コップン・クラップ（※感謝の気持ちを伝える言葉）、EGATさん。僕たちを引き合わせて、今日こうして幸せを共有する機会をくださってありがとうございます。クリーンエネルギーについても学べました。
translations.en: Thank you to EGAT for Bringing us all together. And giving us the chance to share this happiness today. We got to learn about clean energy.
translations.ko: 우리 모두를 한자리에 모아준 EGAT에 감사드립니다. 그리고 오늘 이 행복을 나눌 기회를 주셔서요. 청정 에너지에 대해서도 알게 되었죠.
translations.zh-TW: 謝謝 EGAT 把我們聚在一起，讓我們有機會在今天分享這份快樂，還讓我們了解了乾淨能源。
translations.id: Terima kasih kepada EGAT karena telah menyatukan kita semua. Dan memberi kita kesempatan untuk berbagi kebahagiaan hari ini. Kita bisa belajar tentang energi bersih.
translations.pt: Obrigado à EGAT por nos reunir. E por nos dar a chance de compartilhar essa felicidade hoje. Pudemos aprender sobre energia limpa.

transcript.text: We learned how we can help the planet. Even if it's just in a small way.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ダイ・リーン・ルー・ワー・ラオ・サイ・チュアイ・ローク・ダイ・ヤンガイ・ベン・スアン・レックレック・コー・タイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: We learned how we can help the planet . Even if it 's just in a small way .

translations.ja: たとえ小さなことからでも、僕たちがどうやって地球を助けられるかを学べました。
translations.en: We learned how we can help the planet. Even if it's just in a small way.
translations.ko: 지구를 도울 수 있는 방법에 대해 배웠습니다. 비록 아주 작은 일일지라도요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們學到了如何為地球盡一份心力，即使只是微薄的力量。
translations.id: Kita belajar bagaimana kita dapat membantu planet ini. Meskipun itu hanya dengan cara yang kecil.
translations.pt: Aprendemos como podemos ajudar o planeta. Mesmo que seja de uma forma pequena.

transcript.text: Starting with these small steps… [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED.]
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ラーイ・トン・ジャーク・ジュット・レックレック・ニー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Starting with these small steps … [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED .]

translations.ja: この小さな一歩から始めていきましょう…（※一人ひとりが始める小さな一歩が大きな未来をつくる）
translations.en: Starting with these small steps… [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED.]
translations.ko: 이런 작은 발걸음부터 시작해서… [시작을 위해 우리 각자 작은 역할을 해봐요.]
translations.zh-TW: 從這些小小的腳步開始……[讓我們各自踏出第一小步。]
translations.id: Dimulai dari langkah-langkah kecil ini... [MARI KITA MASING-MASING AMBIL PERAN KECIL UNTUK MEMULAI.]
translations.pt: Começando com esses pequenos passos… [CADA UM DE NÓS FAÇA A SUA PARTE PARA COMEÇAR.]

transcript.text: [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED.]
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ラーイ・トン・ジャーク・ジュット・レックレック・ニー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED .]

translations.ja: （※一人ひとりが始める小さな一歩が大きな未来をつくる）
translations.en: [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED.]
translations.ko: [시작을 위해 우리 각자 작은 역할을 해봐요.]
translations.zh-TW: [讓我們各自踏出第一小步。]
translations.id: [MARI KITA MASING-MASING AMBIL PERAN KECIL UNTUK MEMULAI.]
translations.pt: [CADA UM DE NÓS FAÇA A SUA PARTE PARA COMEÇAR.]

transcript.text: Is what makes something big possible. [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED.] Visiting Khao Kheow was another dream of mine. I'd never been here before. This is my first time.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: イズ・ワット・メイクス・サムシング・ビッグ・ポッシブル・カオ・キアオ・ワズ・アナザー・ドリーム・オブ・マイン・アイド・ネバー・ビーン・ヒア・ビフォー・ディス・イズ・マイ・ファースト・タイム
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Is what makes something big possible . [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED .] Visiting Khao Kheow was another dream of mine . I 'd never been here before . This is my first time .

translations.ja: 大きなことを達成することにつながるんだ。カオキアオ（※カオキアオ・オープン動物園）に来るのも僕の夢の1つだったんだよ。ここには来たことがなくて、今回が初めてなんだ
translations.en: Is what makes something big possible. [LET'S EACH PLAY A SMALL PART IN GETTING STARTED.] Visiting Khao Kheow was another dream of mine. I'd never been here before. This is my first time.
translations.ko: 무언가 거대한 일을 가능하게 만드는 법이죠. [시작을 위해 우리 각자 작은 역할을 해봐요.] 카오키여우 방문은 또 하나의 제 꿈이었어요. 와본 적이 한 번도 없었거든요. 이번이 처음이에요.
translations.zh-TW: 就能成就偉大的事。[讓我們各自踏出第一小步。] 參觀綠山動物園是我的另一個夢想，我以前從來沒來過，這是第一次。
translations.id: Adalah hal yang membuat sesuatu yang besar menjadi mungkin. [MARI KITA MASING-MASING AMBIL PERAN KECIL UNTUK MEMULAI.] Mengunjungi Khao Kheow adalah impianku yang lain. Aku belum pernah ke sini sebelumnya. Ini adalah pertama kalinya bagiku.
translations.pt: É o que torna algo grande possível. [CADA UM DE NÓS FAÇA A SUA PARTE PARA COMEÇAR.] Visitar Khao Kheow foi outro sonho meu. Eu nunca tinha estado aqui antes. Esta é a minha primeira vez.

transcript.text: -Don't you usually go to zoos? -I don't get to see many animals. I usually only see dogs and cats. Or ants, mosquitoes, things like that. -Maybe wasps or hornets. -Those are about all I ever see. Thank you for bringing us here today.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ドント・ユー・ユージュアリー・ゴー・トゥー・ズーズ・アイ・ドント・ゲット・トゥー・シー・メニー・アニマルズ・アイ・ユージュアリー・オンリー・シー・ドッグス・アンド・キャッツ・オー・アンツ・モスキートーズ・シングス・ライク・ダット・メイビー・ワスプス・オー・ホーネッツ・ゾーズ・アー・アバウト・オール・アイ・エバー・シー・サンキュー・フォー・ブリンギング・アス・ヒア・トゥデイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: -Don 't you usually go to zoos ? -I don 't get to see many animals . I usually only see dogs and cats . Or ants , mosquitoes , things like that . -Maybe wasps or hornets . -Those are about all I ever see . Thank you for bringing us here today .

translations.ja: 『普段は動物園に行かないの？』『あまり動物を見る機会がなくて。普段見るのは犬や猫、アリや蚊くらいかな』『ハチとかもね』『それくらいしか見ないよ。今日は僕たちをここに連れてきてくれてコップン・クラップ』
translations.en: -Don't you usually go to zoos? -I don't get to see many animals. I usually only see dogs and cats. Or ants, mosquitoes, things like that. -Maybe wasps or hornets. -Those are about all I ever see. Thank you for bringing us here today.
translations.ko: -동물원은 보통 안 가시나요? -동물들을 볼 일이 별로 없어요. 보통은 개랑 고양이밖에 못 보거든요. 아니면 개미나 모기 같은 거요. -말벌이나 땅벌 정도? -그게 제가 보는 전부예요. 오늘 여기 데려와 주셔서 감사합니다.
translations.zh-TW: -你們平常都不去動物園嗎？ -我沒機會看太多動物，我通常只看得到貓狗，或是螞蟻、蚊子之類的。 -也許還有黃蜂或胡蜂。 -差不多就這些了。謝謝你們今天帶我們來這裡。
translations.id: -Bukankah kamu biasanya pergi ke kebun binatang? -Aku jarang melihat hewan. Aku biasanya hanya melihat anjing dan kucing. Atau semut, nyamuk, hal-hal seperti itu. -Mungkin tawon atau lebah hornet. -Hanya itu yang biasanya kulihat. Terima kasih telah membawa kami ke sini hari ini.
translations.pt: -Você não costuma ir a zoológicos? -Não consigo ver muitos animais. Geralmente só vejo cães e gatos. Ou formigas, mosquitos, coisas assim. -Talvez vespas ou marimbondos. -São quase só esses que eu vejo. Obrigado por nos trazer aqui hoje.

transcript.text: And thank you to everyone who came here today. That was amazing!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アンド・サンキュー・トゥー・エブリワン・フー・ケイム・ヒア・トゥデイ・ダット・ワズ・アメイジング
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And thank you to everyone who came here today . That was amazing !

translations.ja: そして今日ここに来てくれたみなさんもコップン・クラップ！本当にアメイジングでした！
translations.en: And thank you to everyone who came here today. That was amazing!
translations.ko: 그리고 오늘 이곳을 찾아주신 모든 분께 감사드립니다. 정말 최고였어요!
translations.zh-TW: 也謝謝今天到場的每一個人，這太棒了！
translations.id: Dan terima kasih kepada semua orang yang datang ke sini hari ini. Itu sangat luar biasa!
translations.pt: E obrigado a todos que vieram aqui hoje. Isso foi incrível!

transcript.text: I'm so happy to have met all the younger artists, every group that joined us this season. Hope the viewers have received lots of good energy.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイム・ソー・ハッピー・トゥー・ハブ・メット・オール・ザ・ヤンガー・アーティスツ・エブリ・グループ・ダット・ジョインド・アス・ディス・シーズン・ホープ・ザ・ビューアーズ・ハブ・リシーブド・ロッツ・オブ・グッド・エナジー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 'm so happy to have met all the younger artists , every group that joined us this season . Hope the viewers have received lots of good energy .

translations.ja: 今シーズン一緒に参加してくれた後輩アーティストや全グループのみんなに会えてすごく嬉しかったです。視聴者の皆さんもたくさんの良いエネルギーを受け取ってくれたら嬉しいな
translations.en: I'm so happy to have met all the younger artists, every group that joined us this season. Hope the viewers have received lots of good energy.
translations.ko: 이번 시즌에 함께해 준 모든 후배 아티스트분들을 만나서 정말 기쁩니다. 시청자분들도 좋은 에너지를 많이 받으셨길 바라요.
translations.zh-TW: 很高興能認識所有年輕的藝術家們，以及這一季加入我們的每一個團體。希望觀眾們都收到了滿滿的正能量。
translations.id: Aku sangat senang bisa bertemu dengan semua artis junior, setiap grup yang bergabung dengan kita musim ini. Semoga para penonton mendapatkan banyak energi positif.
translations.pt: Estou tão feliz por ter conhecido todos os artistas mais jovens, cada grupo que se juntou a nós nesta temporada. Espero que os telespectadores tenham recebido muita energia boa.

transcript.text: And clean energy, too. Just like all the idols who got to learn so much today.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アンド・クリーン・エナジー・トゥー・ジャスト・ライク・オール・ザ・アイドルズ・フー・ゴット・トゥー・ラーン・ソー・マッチ・トゥデイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And clean energy , too . Just like all the idols who got to learn so much today .

translations.ja: そしてクリーンエネルギーもね！今日たくさんのことを学んだアイドルたちと同じようにね
translations.en: And clean energy, too. Just like all the idols who got to learn so much today.
translations.ko: 청정 에너지도 함께 말이죠. 오늘 많은 것을 배운 모든 아이돌들처럼요.
translations.zh-TW: 還有乾淨能源，就像今天學到許多的偶像們一樣。
translations.id: Dan energi bersih juga. Sama seperti semua idola yang telah belajar banyak hari ini.
translations.pt: E energia limpa também. Assim como todos os ídolos que puderam aprender tanto hoje.

transcript.pronunciation_kana: イフ・ユーイド・ライク・トゥー・ラーン・モア・アバウト・グリーン・エナジー・エレクトリック・ビークルズ・アンド・イーブイ・チャージング・オー・イーブン・ソーラー・セルズ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: If you 'd like to learn more about green energy ... Electric vehicles and EV charging … Or even solar cells …

translations.en: If you'd like to learn more about green energy... Electric vehicles and EV charging… Or even solar cells…
translations.ko: 친환경 에너지에 대해 더 알고 싶으시다면… 전기차와 EV 충전… 또는 태양광 패널까지…
translations.zh-TW: 如果你想了解更多關於綠色能源的資訊……像是電動車、電動車充電桩……甚至是太陽能板……
translations.id: Jika kalian ingin belajar lebih banyak tentang energi hijau... Kendaraan listrik dan pengisian daya EV... Atau bahkan sel surya...
translations.pt: Se você quiser saber mais sobre energia verde... Veículos elétricos e carregamento de VEs… Ou até mesmo células solares…

translations.zh-TW: 你可以關注 EGAT 的各大頻道。雖然這是最後一集……但你仍然可以再次觀看……

translations.zh-TW: 在 GMMTV 的 YouTube 頻道上。來跟我們一起補充正能量，重溫這些回憶吧。
